narration_timeline.text: Why are these goats spread across a hillside like a living lawn mower?
narration_timeline.scene: Real managed goat herd grazing across grassy slope.

narration_timeline.text: A group can move together through open ground, searching for vegetation within reach.
narration_timeline.scene: Goat herd on rocky ground, clearly a separate location.

narration_timeline.text: Some goats pause in the grass, while others lower their heads to eat hay, choosing plants from one patch to another.
narration_timeline.scene: One goat rests in a grassy meadow, followed by close goats visibly eating hay.

narration_timeline.text: Between meals, goats also pause to groom or rest; feeding is only part of their day, especially in a quiet managed pen.
narration_timeline.scene: Goats grooming and goats resting in managed barn.

narration_timeline.text: Young kids have a different priority, staying close to their mothers for milk.
narration_timeline.scene: Real mother goat with nursing newborn kids.

narration_timeline.text: From nursing kids to a watchful adult in a grassy enclosure, goat life is more than grazing.
narration_timeline.scene: Adult goat standing alert in a grassy fenced enclosure; no claim of active grazing.
